# Project: CampusConnect
Full-stack MERN college project (NoSQL/MongoDB focus).
Stack: React + Vite + Tailwind, Node + Express, MongoDB Atlas + Mongoose, JWT, bcrypt, Axios, Cloudinary.

## Rules
- Read docs/PROJECT_BRIEF.md for full requirements.
- NEVER create mock/fake data. Use real API calls, with loading/empty/error states.
- Prioritize a working MVP over extra features.
- Structure: client/ (React) and server/ (Express) as in the brief.
- Never commit .env. Keep .env.example updated.
- Explain code simply; I must explain it in a viva.
- Give exact terminal commands and test steps for every change.
- Work one phase at a time. Stop after each phase and wait for me.
